description: Admin improvements group A: paper archive (migration 005), admin activity log (migration 006), bulk CSV import, and notification bell. Also adds the service worker for PWA (public/sw.js). Independent from FEAT-002 public features. Depends on FEAT-001 for ToastProvider (useToast in admin tables).
steps: Create supabase/migrations/005_archive.sql: ALTER TABLE public.papers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

Create supabase/migrations/006_activity_log.sql: CREATE TABLE public.activity_log (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), action text NOT NULL, details jsonb, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); ALTER TABLE public.activity_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY "Admins can read activity log" ON public.activity_log FOR SELECT USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin')); CREATE POLICY "Admins can insert activity log" ON public.activity_log FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'));

Edit src/types/database.ts: (a) Add `archived: boolean` to PapersRow. Add `archived?: boolean` to PapersInsert and PapersUpdate. Add `publish_at: string | null` to PapersRow. Add `publish_at?: string | null` to PapersInsert and PapersUpdate. Add `tags: string[]` to PapersRow. Add `tags?: string[]` to PapersInsert and PapersUpdate. (b) Add ActivityLogRow = { id:string; action:string; details:Record<string,unknown>|null; created_at:string }, ActivityLogInsert = { id?:string; action:string; details?:Record<string,unknown>|null; created_at?:string }. Add activity_log to Database.public.Tables: { Row: ActivityLogRow; Insert: ActivityLogInsert; Update: Partial<ActivityLogInsert>; Relationships: [] }.

Edit src/lib/validations.ts: (a) Add to paperUpdateSchema: `archived: z.boolean().optional()`. (b) Add to paperInsertSchema and paperUpdateSchema: `publish_at: z.string().optional()` and `tags: z.array(z.string()).optional()`. Note: if searchSchema changes were made in FEAT-002, ensure they are not duplicated here — only add if not already present.

Edit src/app/(public)/page.tsx: add `.eq('archived', false)` filter to the public papers query (after the `.eq('status', 'published')` call). This ensures archived papers never show in public results.

Create src/app/api/admin/log/route.ts: POST handler. Check admin session: import createClient from @/lib/supabase/server; const supabase = await createClient(); const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession(); if (!session) return Response.json({error:'Unauthorized'},{status:401}). Parse body: { action:string; details?:Record<string,unknown> }. Validate: action must be non-empty string. Use createAdminClient() to insert: .from('activity_log').insert({ action, details: details ?? null }). Return { ok:true }. On error return 500.

Create src/app/(admin)/admin/activity/page.tsx: server component. Import createAdminClient. Fetch last 50 log entries: .from('activity_log').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(50). Render table with columns: Time (formatted with toLocaleDateString + toLocaleTimeString), Action, Details (JSON.stringify(details) truncated to 100 chars). Add AdminNav at top.

Edit src/components/AdminNav.tsx: add { href: '/admin/activity', label: 'Activity' } and { href: '/admin/import', label: 'Import' } to NAV_LINKS. Also replace the static Messages link with a new NotificationBell component (see next step).

Create src/app/api/admin/unread-count/route.ts: GET handler. Check admin session. Use createAdminClient() to count: .from('contact_messages').select('id',{count:'exact',head:true}).eq('read',false). Return { count: number }.

Create src/components/NotificationBell.tsx: 'use client'. On mount: fetch /api/admin/unread-count. Read localStorage pq:messagesLastVisited (timestamp or null). If count>0 AND (lastVisited is null OR Date.now()-lastVisited > 5*60*1000) show red badge with count. On click navigate to /admin/messages using router.push. Also: if current pathname is /admin/messages, call localStorage.setItem('pq:messagesLastVisited', Date.now().toString()) on mount. Render: `Messages{count>0 && {count>9?'9+':count}}`

Edit src/components/AdminNav.tsx (second edit): import NotificationBell. In NAV_LINKS, remove the static { href: '/admin/messages', label: 'Messages' } entry. Add NotificationBell as a separate JSX element after the NAV_LINKS.map() block (not inside it, since it's a component not a simple link). The nav flex container renders: NAV_LINKS links + <NotificationBell /> inline.

Edit src/components/PapersTable.tsx: (a) Add Archive/Unarchive button in the action column. Paper rows with archived=true get `opacity-60` class. Archive button calls PATCH /api/papers/${paper.id} with { archived: true/false }. Update local state after success. (b) Add fire-and-forget activity log calls: after toggleStatus success call `fetch('/api/admin/log',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:newStatus==='published'?'paper_published':'paper_drafted',details:{id:paper.id,title:paper.title}})}).catch(()=>{})`. After delete success: `fetch('/api/admin/log',...,{action:'paper_deleted',details:{id,title}})` fire-and-forget.

Edit src/components/UploadForm.tsx: (a) Add tags input: `<label htmlFor='tags' className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600'>Tags (comma-separated, optional)</label><input type='text' id='tags' value={tags} onChange={e=>setTags(e.target.value)} placeholder='e.g. MCQ, Theory, Objective' className={inputClass} />`. (b) Include `tags: tags.split(',').map(t=>t.trim()).filter(Boolean)` in the paper insert/update PATCH body. (c) Add activity log fire-and-forget after upload success: `fetch('/api/admin/log',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'paper_uploaded',details:{title,courseId}})}).catch(()=>{})`. (d) Add optional publish_at input: `<label htmlFor='publish-at' className='mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600'>Schedule publish (optional)</label><input type='datetime-local' id='publish-at' value={publishAt} onChange={e=>setPublishAt(e.target.value)} className={inputClass} />`. Include publishAt in payload if non-empty: `...(publishAt ? { publish_at: new Date(publishAt).toISOString() } : {})`.

Create src/app/(admin)/admin/import/page.tsx: 'use client'. File input accept='.csv'. On file change: read file text, split by newlines, skip header row (title,course_code,year,semester,level), parse each row by splitting on comma and trimming. Validate each row: title non-empty, year is 1990-2030, semester is first/second/resit, level is 100/200/300/400/500. Show preview table with valid/invalid row indicators. Submit button (disabled until rows are parsed, enabled when at least 1 valid row): POST /api/admin/import with { rows: validRows }. Show result: '{n} papers imported successfully. {m} rows failed.' with details.

Create src/app/api/admin/import/route.ts: POST handler. Require admin session. Parse body { rows: {title,course_code,year,semester,level}[] }. For each row: look up course_id via .from('courses').select('id').eq('code',row.course_code).maybeSingle(). If not found, record error. Build insert array for valid rows with status:'draft'. Bulk insert with createAdminClient().from('papers').insert(papers). Return { inserted:number; errors:{row:number;reason:string}[] }. Log activity: fire-and-forget `fetch('/api/admin/log',...)` with action 'papers_bulk_imported' and details count.

Create public/sw.js: service worker file. Cache name 'pq-v1'. Shell URLs: ['/', '/courses', '/bookmarks']. install event: cache.addAll(SHELL_URLS) + self.skipWaiting(). activate event: delete old caches, self.clients.claim(). fetch event: (1) skip API routes (pathname starts with /api/) and supabase hostnames — let them fall through to network. (2) Cache-first for static assets (.js,.css,.png,.jpg,.ico,.woff2). (3) Network-first for pages: try fetch, cache successful response, fall back to cache on failure.
Create src/components/ServiceWorkerRegistration.tsx: 'use client'. useEffect on mount: if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(()=>{}). Returns null.
Edit src/app/layout.tsx: import ServiceWorkerRegistration. Add `<ServiceWorkerRegistration />` inside body after the closing ViewTransitions/ToastProvider but before the watermark span.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors
npm run test:unit passes all 30 tests
PapersTable has Archive/Unarchive button and logs actions to /api/admin/log
AdminNav includes Activity and Import links and NotificationBell in place of static Messages link
public/sw.js exists and is a valid service worker
src/components/ServiceWorkerRegistration.tsx exists and is added to root layout
